messages.msgid: You were unwittingly subject to next gen CRISPR experimentation that has resulted in you growing a small gland out of your pancreas that gradually mutates you with alpha traits.
translations: 在不知情的情况下，你成为了次世代CRISPR基因编辑实验的对象，这导致你的胰腺上长出了一个小腺体，它会让你逐渐展现出阿尔法系的突变特征。
